

# cmicpl.cpl is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cmicpl-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(cmicpl_shims OBJECT cmicpl.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cmicpl_shims PRIVATE libshell32 libmsvcrt libkernel32)
target_compile_definitions(cmicpl_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_dependencies(cmicpl_shims psdk)
add_cargo_module(cmicpl cmicpl-cargo cmicpl.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS cmicpl_shims psdk)
